sections.content: The gerund can show two developments happening in parallel.

items.spanish: Los gobiernos negociaban con los acreedores, intentando reducir la presión financiera.
items.english: Governments negotiated with creditors, trying to reduce financial pressure.

items.spanish: Muchas familias afrontaban el desempleo, reduciendo sus gastos para adaptarse.
items.english: Many families faced unemployment, reducing their spending to adapt.

items.spanish: Los salarios perdían poder adquisitivo, aumentando la presión sobre los hogares.
items.english: Wages were losing purchasing power, increasing pressure on households.

items.spanish: La pobreza aumentaba mientras el salario real seguía cayendo en algunos sectores.
items.english: Poverty was increasing while real wages continued to fall in some sectors.

sections.content: The gerund should normally have the same logical subject as the main clause.
